subject: Welcome to the private server.
description:
Author of the private server here (ArithSeq, qwerfd2, whatever).

I thought of lots of things to write here, but in the end, I don't think it matters. This is a dead game, and few, if any of its former players, will remember it today.

This may not have been a good game. we can critique it all day. But it is clear to me that there was a team passionate about classical music that made this happen.

However, they are not credited in-game, and the game itself is lost to time.

Fret not, I will not let any of it happen.

Below is the staff roll extracted from the Switch version of this game. I have evidence that this also applies to the mobile version.

Note that this game might contain outsourced works. Outsourcing is a serious problem in the game industry right now and have caused crunches, psycological and sometimes physical abuse, and lower wages (watch youtube video RR9HQ2C6h_4 if you wish to be depressed for the next hour - or day, or longer).

This is not to say that those associated with this game have been through these, but do note that they might not be in the staff roll.

If anyone who worked on this game is reading, I hope you moved on to better places.
